title: 第25章 苏家退婚叶家退婚第26章 一纸诏书陛下的态度
content_zh:
“你之前那高高在上的话语，此刻再想起，是否会感到羞愧？”
“通窍境，二阶灵兵，你究竟有什么骄傲的资本？”
叶无尘平静的开口道。
他的气势，依旧是那么的可怕，这淡漠的声音如同一记耳光一般抽打在苏清雪脸上。
“执迷不悟，既然如此，你好自为之吧。”
“看在相识一场的份上，我最后再给你一次机会，认输吧。”
这些话，都是苏清雪不久之前说的，可现在的结果，又是如何？
叶无尘手持银枪，继续迈步向前。
苏清雪的脸色十分难看，叶无尘没有直接出手，而是缓步朝他走来，这是什么意思，她心知肚明。
当初的她，便也是想通过这种方式让叶无尘亲口认输。
少年的身影越来越近，身上的杀意也越来越强。
“你若是真的骄傲，那便一直沉默着吧。”
叶无尘的话语让苏清雪浑身开始颤抖了起来。
感受着他身上越来越强大的气势与越来越浓烈的杀意。
苏清雪脸上不由得露出了一抹耻辱的神色，随即低声开口道：“我...认输。”
短短的三个字仿佛抽干苏清雪所有的气力一般。
听闻此言，叶无尘也是停下了身形。
少年傲立于擂台之上，阳光洒落在他的身上，此刻的少年，似乎有着一股特殊的魅力。
苏清雪抬头看向这一幕，眼眸露出了一抹复杂的神色。
似愤怒，似不解，又好似懊悔。

只见她缓缓的转过身，跳下了战台，一脸落寞的朝看台处走去。
看台上，叶夕月露出了一抹灿烂的笑意。
甚至，就连叶卿卿的嘴角都勾起了一抹弧度。
看台最上方，叶南天看到这一幕，眼中似有热泪流淌，随后竟不顾形象的仰头大笑了起来。
“哈哈哈哈...好！
好！
好！”
叶南天此刻根本无法抑制自己内心的激动之情。
一身聚海二重的修为展露无疑，深深的压迫着在场的每一个人。
只是看着擂台上傲立的少年，叶南天都难以按捺心中压抑了多年的心绪。
四年来，叶家被迫退出京城，落脚于武安城之中。
content_en:
"If you think about those condescending words you said before, will you feel ashamed now?"
"Tongqiao Realm, second-level spiritual soldier, what do you have to be proud of?"
Ye Wuchen said calmly.
His momentum was still so terrifying, and this indifferent voice slapped Su Qingxue on the face like a slap.
"You are obsessed with it. If that's the case, you can take care of yourself."
"For the sake of getting acquainted, I will give you one last chance. Just admit defeat."
These words were all said by Su Qingxue not long ago, but what is the result now?
Ye Wuchen held the silver gun and continued to move forward.
Su Qingxue's face was very ugly. Ye Wuchen did not take action directly, but walked towards him slowly. She knew what this meant.
At the beginning, she also wanted to use this method to make Ye Wuchen admit defeat personally.
The boy's figure is getting closer and closer, and the murderous intention in his body is getting stronger and stronger.
"If you are really proud, then keep silent."
Ye Wuchen's words made Su Qingxue start to tremble all over.
Feeling his increasingly powerful aura and increasingly intense murderous intent.
Su Qingxue couldn't help but reveal a look of shame on her face, and then she said in a low voice: "I... give up."
These three short words seemed to drain all Su Qingxue's strength away.
Hearing this, Ye Wuchen also stopped.
The young man stood proudly on the ring, with the sun shining on him. At this moment, the young man seemed to have a special charm.
Su Qingxue looked up at this scene, with a complicated look in her eyes.
It seems angry, confused, and regretful.
I saw her slowly turning around, jumping off the platform, and walking towards the stands with a lonely look on her face.
In the stands, Ye Xiyue showed a bright smile.
Even the corners of Ye Qingqing's mouth curled up.
At the top of the stand, Ye Nantian saw this scene, tears seemed to flow from his eyes, and then he threw his head up and laughed regardless of the image.
“Hahahaha...good!
OK!
OK! "
Ye Nantian couldn't suppress the excitement in his heart at this moment.
The cultivation of the second level of Juhai was undoubtedly revealed, deeply oppressing everyone present.
Just looking at the young man standing proudly on the ring, Ye Nantian could not suppress the emotions that had been suppressed for many years.
In the past four years, the Ye family was forced to withdraw from the capital and settled in Wu'an City.
